slides.say: On a Node server, render to pipeable stream renders your app into a stream of HTML.
Pass your root component and a list of bootstrap scripts. When the shell is ready, set the content type and pipe the stream into the response.
Your root component returns the whole document, including the html tag. React adds the doctype and your script tags for you.
In the bootstrap script, hydrate the entire document. That attaches event listeners to the server HTML.

slides.text: Node.js: renderToPipeableStream. Web Streams (Deno, edge): renderToReadableStream.
slides.say: One takeaway: on Node, use render to pipeable stream. On Deno or edge runtimes with web streams, use render to readable stream.
